title: I Heart Art
description: 2:30 PM – 3:30 PM · Join us in the Youth Programming space for a fall break I Heart Art! We will be making placemats - make your own or make one to donate to our local Senior Lunch!

title: Dance Fit Fusion with Marlen
description: 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Join Marlen for a high-energy dance fitness class fused with barre, pilates and stretching that mixes low-intensity and high-intensity moves for an interval-style, calorie-burning workout that will tone your body and boost your endurance without even realizing how hard you are working. It is exercise in disguise! No dance experience is required—just bring your energy, a water bottle, and a smile. This class is free and open to the public, but donations for the instructor are always welcome. Únete a Marlen para una clase de fitness de baile llena de energía combinada con barre, pilates y estiramientos que combina movimientos de baja y alta intensidad para un entrenamiento de intervalos que quema calorías, tonificando tu cuerpo y aumentando tu resistencia sin darte cuenta de lo duro que estás trabajando. ¡Es ejercicio disfrazado! …
